O.content: The title reads "Married couple vs Single women"; "Married couple" is printed in blue beside the left side of the plot and "Single women" is printed in red beside the right side.
At the printed x-axis tick "2020", a red dashed-line square is higher on the page than a blue solid-line circle.
The red series uses square marks connected by a dashed line, while the blue series uses circular marks connected by a solid line.

B.text: If the chart’s horizontal Year axis binds points to their aligned year ticks, the blue solid-circle series is Married couple and the red dashed-square series is Single women as indicated by the visible series labels, and higher vertical placement encodes a larger group count, then the higher 2020 series has the larger 2020 count. Under the task instruction, open that group’s follow-up record.
B.conditions: Applies to the two plotted series at the 2020 tick; assumes the dashboard uses the conventional upward-increasing count scale despite unlabeled y-axis values.
